scientific_integrity: Proof is a direct combinatorial CW graph-of-spaces construction; finite GF(2) calculations corroborate but are not used as infinite proof. No independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to simple cycle bouquets with at least two petals and target cycles of length at least five.
Full novelty may be affected by unindexed equivalent results; prior type-only statements are acknowledged.
title: A product-counted point–circle classification for Hom complexes of cycle bouquets
